newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Mobil Singapore shuts 45,000-bpd crude unit.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Singapore shuts 45,000-bpd crude unit.

text.p: Mobil Singapore, a unit of Mobil Corp of the U.S., shut a 45,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) crude unit earlier this week owing to technical problems, an industry source said on Friday.
And a Singapore Refining Co source said the company planned to cut production 10-15,000 bpd sometime this week at its 285,000-bpd refinery because of shipping delays on crude deliveries.
Mobil operates a 280,000-bpd refinery at Jurong, on the west coast of Singapore.
The source said the closure of the CDU was timely, owing to negative margins that have hit Singapore refiners in the wake of a price plunge in gas oil and fuel oil prices.
He said he was not able to indicate how long the CDU might be shut.
Shell Singapore last Friday said it had cut production by 30,000 bpd at its 435,000 bpd refinery.
Esso Singapore said earlier this week it had cut production at its 230,000 bpd refinery by 20 to 25 percent.
